title: YARA-X 1.22.1 Release, (Sat, Oct 31st)
description: YARA-X version 1.22.1 is a bugfix release that addresses two bugs. This release does not include the new built-in functions for reading 64-bit integers that are present in YARA 4.6.0. YARA-X has effectively replaced YARA as the tool for pattern matching and malware research.
